text_block_list.text:
One day, while Bamboo Memory and I were 
striving toward the Yasuda Kinen... That 
news arrived—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Is it true that Oguri-senpai's running 
in the Yasuda Kinen?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh! Finally!! In our Senior year, I 
get to race Oguri-senpai at my favorite 
distance!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so happyyyy...! I wanna run with 
Oguri-senpai right away!! I wanna compete 
with her!! Nuaaaahhh!!

Bamboo Memory is unable to contain her 
excitement. As always, there isn't a 
single shred of fear in facing Oguri Cap.

"While it's reassuring, it's also a little 
frightening to think about what will 
happen when we actually clash. But—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! To beat Oguri-senpai! Please 
make my training even tougher starting 
today!!

—As long as Bamboo Memory strongly 
believes in her own "dream" and keeps 
charging forward.

As Bamboo Memory's Trainer, I will 
continue to believe in her strength and 
her indomitable spirit.

With only days left until the Yasuda 
Kinen, I reaffirmed my vow to do 
everything in my power for Bamboo Memory's 
victory...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Uoooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...! Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(There seems to be time before the Yasuda 
Kinen, but really there isn't. Not only do 
I need regular training, but I also have 
to step up the quality of my 
self-training—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, after a short break, one more 
set...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hard at work, I see.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Yaeno! You doing some extra training 
too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...Just like you, I also have the 
Yasuda Kinen ahead of me."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait~! We finally get to compete 
with everything we've got against Yaeno, 
and against Oguri-senpai, too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm already super excited! To see just 
what kind of run Oguri-senpai will use to 
stand in my way!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure Oguri-san will put on another 
breathtaking run for us this time as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! Gaaah!! I can't wait to run the 
Yasuda Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san, you really are looking forward 
to it, aren't you? ...Running with 
Oguri-san, that is.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, she's one of the 
strongest, most awesome Umamusume who just 
might make my "dream" come true!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Even though Oguri-san might end up 
devouring your "dream" too?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, what did you mean by—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. That was a slip of the 
tongue just now; please forget it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll... take my leave now—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wait, Yaeno?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I lost sight of them...! If only I 
hadn't just sprinted up those stairs, I 
could've kept chasing...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Even though Oguri-san might end up 
devouring your "dream" too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. That was a slip of the 
tongue just now; please forget it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—I don't get it at all. What Yaeno is 
trying to say, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ……! I can't let it end like this!

—Bamboo Memory told me about what happened 
between her and Yaeno Muteki today...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't really understand what 
Yaeno was trying to say. That's why I 
wanted to ask you, Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai might "devour dreams"... What 
on earth does that even mean...?
choice_data_list:
...This is purely hypothetical, but if you 
don't mind...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Yes sir! Please teach me, sir!!

Regarding the true meaning behind Yaeno 
Muteki's words, I began sharing with 
Bamboo Memory what I thought might 
possibly be the reason—

...One of the reasons the Umamusume named 
Oguri Cap is hailed as the "center of her 
era" lies in the sheer "breadth" of her 
success.

From the mile to long distances, across 
that wide range of turf, she has displayed 
matchless strength to this very day.

"...Could Yaeno Muteki's words have been 
pointing to the consequences that this 
might cause?"

—For instance, suppose there was an 
Umamusume who had absolute confidence in 
mile races and worked tirelessly, 
believing she wouldn't lose to anyone at 
this distance.

She stacked up solid results, even leading 
the public to say, "At this distance, she 
might be the strongest of all," when 
suddenly—

—What if an Umamusume possessing 
overwhelming strength suddenly stood in 
your way?

And what if that Umamusume possessed 
unrivaled strength across other distances 
as well?

"...Much like how the dazzling sun hides 
the light of the stars under a clear blue 
sky, it rewrites the perceptions of 
everyone who witnesses it and all who 
challenge it."

"She is the strongest." "No one can match 
her." "She's bound to win any race."

Compelling someone to actually say those 
words—that is the kind of Umamusume Oguri 
Cap is.

Yaeno Muteki realized that... or perhaps, 
because she was made painfully aware of 
it, she chose to say those words to Bamboo 
Memory.

Because Oguri Cap is so strong and 
dazzling across every distance, her 
brilliance ends up overshadowing the light 
of other Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――I'll end up devouring their "dreams."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...So you're saying Yaeno was trying to 
give me a warning?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Still, hearing you talk about it now, I 
kinda feel like that might actually be 
true.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because Ardan-senpai and Chiyono O both 
said something similar before.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why Yaeno, too...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Alright!! Nailed it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you for listening to my 
troubles! I totally get it now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because you said that, Yaeno, 
all the more reason! I have to give it my 
all when challenging Oguri-senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno needs to see me challenge 
Oguri-senpai! And I have to get through to 
her somehow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That Oguri-senpai is definitely not 
someone who devours dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-senpai told me the other day! That 
for us, 'there are things that can only be 
conveyed through running, not words'!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I can't put into words yet 
how Oguri-senpai is different! But I want 
to get it across no matter what! With my 
running!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this is the only thing I can do 
for Yaeno right now...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, I—
choice_data_list: ...I've gotta get even more fired up!!
...I've got to get even more fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

And so, the fire deep in Bamboo Memory's 
eyes blazed even brighter heading into the 
"Yasuda Kinen"!
